goals: Verify the integrity and security of the client-side MSAL application setup and configuration.
Verify that the application server correctly serves the main index page.
activities: Import the 'supertest' module for HTTP assertions.
Import the 'path' module for handling file paths.
Import the 'fs' module for file system operations.
Import the 'app' module from './server.js'.
Configure Jest to not mock the 'fs' module.
Read the content of 'App/index.html' file into a variable 'html' using 'fs.readFileSync'.
Set the global document's inner HTML to the content of 'index.html' before tests in 'Sanitize index page' block.
Get the HTML element with ID 'load-msal'.
Get the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element.
Assert that the 'src' attribute contains 'https://alcdn.msauth.net/browser'.
Load the 'msalConfig' object from 'App/authConfig.js' into a global variable 'msalConfig' before tests in 'Sanitize configuration object' block.
Assert that the 'msalConfig' object is defined.
Define a regular expression for GUID format.
Test if the 'clientId' property of 'msalConfig.auth' matches the GUID regular expression.
Assert that the 'clientId' property does not match the GUID regular expression.
Define a regular expression for URI format.
Test if the 'authority' property of 'msalConfig.auth' matches the URI regular expression.
Assert that the 'authority' property matches the URI regular expression.
Set the 'NODE_ENV' environment variable to 'test' before tests in 'Ensure pages served' block.
Send an HTTP GET request to the root path ('/') of the 'app'.
Read the content of 'App/index.html' file from disk using 'fs.promises.readFile'.
Assert that the HTTP response status code is 200.
Assert that the HTTP response text content is equal to the content of 'App/index.html'.
